ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Of MpSvc.DLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "MpSvc.dll". Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\MpSvc\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Platform\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\")))
